Sign up. The site then emails confirmation instructions.

Change the signed-in visitor’s name. The site limits how often this may be done.
Change the signed-in visitor’s password. The site signs them in again afterwards.

get.summary: The two factor authentication page: whether it is on and, when it is off, the secret to pair an authenticator app with. The first visit makes the secret.

put.summary: Turn two factor authentication on (the code from the paired app) or off (a code or a backup code). Turning it on answers the backup codes, once.

get.summary: The signed-in visitor's own API key, read from their account page.
The captcha the site asks for at sign-in, so the browser can show it.
